export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
export PYTHONPATH=/tmp/tidetrain-scale/code
mkdir -p /tmp/tidetrain-scale
python3 - <<'TIDETRAIN_SOURCE'
import base64,hashlib,io,json,sys,zipfile,zlib
from pathlib import Path
assert sys.version_info[:2]==(3,11),'Offline dependency requires CPython 3.11'
root=Path('/tmp/tidetrain-scale/code/lowband_training')
root.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
wheel=base64.b64decode('')
assert hashlib.sha256(wheel).hexdigest()=='a6c19feda32b931cae0acd42748a670bdf56bee6476a046af20181ad3fee4090','Dependency hash mismatch'
with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(wheel)) as archive:
 for name in archive.namelist():
  assert not Path(name).is_absolute() and '..' not in Path(name).parts
 archive.extractall(root.parent)
blobs=json.loads(zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode('')))
hashes={'__init__.py': 'bdda15f446def7e045047d1ef08b83ae0083bb58a3650de932e7c293e51d3309', 'storage.py': '247560a485a8845912dbc4f09de4b96dd06162c75413e089969c4f8d9b90fa40', 'protocol.py': 'e319288e3cd1be93f4ca5f7fcd58e7306b6698e98989d2492163df9d92740b7a', 'train.py': '448d30e2963fd34185a35cdb4274517cc1ed3bec08af9f60e6de1fafb66b0a10', 'shards.py': 'deecfa34a9802bbff44f39f36298e2232f4d4ac2b41c60fe7da5c92223ebf933', 'ledger.py': '34ca090019c3ad2e82a3490e250803440d15b3508ee8e6dc975acc51bc645841', 'http_transport.py': '72594de9a608bbb2b08f05b6f9e254d906c30d1e8ffc8b2a9ee1a660bac9687f', 'scale_worker.py': '73cc4dd2ba750e486ee002792b4e36a6b70653ce95f3f1c32acdce9ea79a4fbf', 'scale_node.py': 'e233e96110a31b62cea6a0151d50356ef8adac6d0eb1b10bcd203c09cd01ab23', 'cuda_bootstrap.py': '3bafb15e54a0bd674977c8e299961aee93cf19258e866772f0d863119fa812ec'}
for name,blob in blobs.items():
 data=base64.b64decode(blob)
 assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==hashes[name],name
 (root/name).write_bytes(data)
print(json.dumps({'event':'source_verified','hashes':hashes}),flush=True)
import safetensors
assert safetensors.__version__=='0.4.5'
print(json.dumps({'event':'offline_dependency_verified','version':safetensors.__version__,
 'wheel_sha256':'a6c19feda32b931cae0acd42748a670bdf56bee6476a046af20181ad3fee4090'}),flush=True)
